grammarExplanation:
This is a special testing module to master Ser vs. Estar. 

• For the first 10 prompts, you will be given a sentence in English and a rule. Translate it using 'estar' (Locations).
• Then you'll translate 5 sentences from scratch.
• Next, 10 prompts using 'ser' (Characteristics).
• Finally, a mix of translations combining everything you've learned!
